capabilities: store a plugin registry in S3-compatible storage
extras: The README contains only the one-line description and a note that releases are built by a GitHub workflow; no usage or configuration instructions are provided.
problem: Obsidian stores plugins per vault, so there is no built-in way to carry an installed plugin setup across vaults or machines.
summary: Local plugin registry manager that syncs your Obsidian plugin set to S3-compatible storage and restores it in other vaults.
